name: Dearest Elenia,
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. Places are Classic’s, shown on the Forever maps. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details:
Have you ever known love, young one? It was a thing foreign to me until lately, when I met a girl from the Undercity, Elenia. It is rare enough for one of my kind to look outside our own, let alone one of the Forsaken.

But now thoughts of her occupy my mind both days and nights.

If you can, could you take this letter to her? I want her to come here to Mulgore. I hope that she will say yes.
narrative.objectives: Deliver the Carefully Written Letter to Elenia Haydon near the bank in the Undercity.
narrative.offerRewardText:
What kind words Temma writes for me. But, as much as his words move me, I cannot consider the love of a tauren. In thoughts, body and mind we are too different.

It is good I do not have to receive these thoughts of his in person. I could not bear to break his heart.
narrative.requestItemsText: Oh, and to what do I owe this pleasure?
